questions.question: Can extending the expiry bring an already expired link back to life?
questions.why: This is an explicitly listed product-policy question. Choosing either behavior changes whether previously expired links become usable again.

questions.question: Is there a maximum expiry, and if so, what is it?
questions.why: This is an explicitly listed product-policy question. A limit could affect customer commitments and operational or security policy, so a default should not be guessed.
